S2-M02

MAJOR | Process containment and cleanup guarantees lack the required platform proof | Evidence: docs/S2_SANDBOX_WORKER_PLAN_2026-10-24.md, E4; docs/changes/0211-s2-e4-wsl-skip-triage.md; docs/sdlc/STATE.md.

Failure scenario: A command creates descendants or encounters timeout/cleanup failure. The implementation's intended containment and cleanup behavior cannot be accepted solely from code inspection, ordinary subprocess success, POSIX lock tests or synthetic identity checks.

The exact evidence correctly leaves process-group/descendant cleanup, Windows Job Object nesting, and full POSIX containment unverified. Change 0211 establishes that four E4 entries are unconditional skip-placeholder values, not four runnable passing tests.

Required change: Obtain authorized platform-specific containment evidence, preserving the explicit prohibitions, or document a scoped release limitation that does not claim process-tree containment acceptance.

S2-M03

MAJOR | The operational sandbox binding and enforced resource boundaries are not established | Evidence: docs/SANDBOX_SPEC.md, Resource and filesystem limits and Required pre-flight evidence; tools/vst/supervisor.py::start_worker; docs/changes/0081-s2-fail-closed-bounded-object-import.md; docs/sdlc/STATE.md.

Failure scenario: A valid signed inventory and network-policy attestation belong to one verified environment, but the worker-start callback is not demonstrably tied to a deployment with the same namespace, approved workspace and enforced resource controls. Alternatively, a direct writer outside SyntheticOperationBackend changes target storage without participating in its advisory lock.

The source implements fail-closed preflight verification and a logical cumulative object-storage cap. It does not, by itself, prove an OS memory limit, temporary-filesystem quota, exact workspace binding or exclusion of external writers.

Required change: Supply a run-scoped deployment contract that binds worker execution to the verified sandbox and demonstrates effective quotas and exclusive target ownership. Keep these properties NOT_VERIFIED until observed; do not treat the 512 MiB logical object cap as a filesystem quota.
